data.title: ORSC R327 local adoption
data.description: Municipalities that have adopted ORSC Section R327, from Oregon BCD’s published list and from a city ordinance where BCD has not yet listed the place. Status is adoption of the code section, not a map of every tax lot.
data.author: grayson-graham

rows.name: Ashland
rows.sourceTitle: Oregon BCD Home hardening and wildfire hazard mitigation
rows.notes: On BCD’s published list as of 23 August 2026. Ordinance URL not found in this pass.

rows.name: Deschutes County
rows.notes: Unincorporated county. Mandatory for new dwellings and new accessory structures from 1 April 2026.

rows.name: Sisters
rows.notes: City code adopts ORSC R327 for the entirety of Sisters. BCD also lists Sisters. Deschutes County states the provisions are mandatory from 1 April 2026. Deschutes County Building Safety administers the code for the city.

rows.name: Bend
rows.notes: Second reading and roll-call adoption 15 April 2026. Exhibit A amends BMC 9.10.010 E so ORSC R327 applies in all Bend city limits. Listed on the city’s ordinances index as adopted 15 April 2026. City ordinances take effect 30 days after roll-call adoption unless the ordinance states otherwise. Do not treat seminar attendance or city news as the source. Not on BCD’s published R327 list as of 23 August 2026.
